text:
deploy-bot: flagged potential regression for release v3.8.4 on embeddings - auto-rollback scheduled in 5m if no human ack. metric=embedding_timeout_rate 5m=1.8% (threshold=1.0%). suggested_action=hold-and-investigate or cancel-auto-rollback. /alert @rachel @miko

rachel: ack. I'm on call. what's the scope?

deploy-bot: affected_slices=[canary, staged-embed-slice], impacted_customers=unknown, 5xx_count=12 in last 4m.

miko: seeing similar in logs. timeouts from grpc pool hitting deadline on gpu-0. stack traces show `DeadlineExceeded` at embedding-worker.

dave: could be a batching regression. recent commit changed default batch timeout from 250ms -> 400ms to accommodate long sequences. maybe it's interacting with autoscaler.

tina: support queue shows three customer reports referencing timeouts and truncated responses. ticket numbers attached to support dashboard.

rachel: options: 1) cancel auto-rollback and hotfix in canary, 2) pin canary traffic back to 3.8.3, 3) let auto-rollback proceed. I prefer pin + hotfix if fast.

ops-bot: runbook suggestion: if timeout_rate between 1-2% and p95 latency unchanged -> prefer pin and deploy targeted fix.

miko: agree. quick check: p95 latency for embeddings is stable at 260ms. timeouts concentrated on requests with >1024 tokens in batch.

dave: I can revert the batch-timeout change and build a patch. building now (CI short build).

ci-bot: workflow start: build-patch by dave at 1765559120

ci-bot: build succeeded. artifact=embed-patch-3.8.4-rollback-batchtime

dave: deploying patch to canary behind feature flag `batch-timeout-fix`. will not touch dedicated pools.

ci-bot: deploy triggered by dave at 1765559203 -> canary; flag=batch-timeout-fix

miko: monitoring traces. initial 10m sample shows timeout_rate dropping to 0.3% on patched canary.

rachel: good. canceling auto-rollback. @deploy-bot cancel auto-rollback for v3.8.4 canary.

deploy-bot: auto-rollback cancelled by rachel at 1765559225. confirmation id=cancel-1765559225

tina: sending short customer note: "We've applied a fix to reduce embedding timeouts on canary. If you continue to see issues, please open a ticket and include request id." posting to #customer-notify.

dave: will open a PR to revert the batch timeout default and add an integration test for long-sequence batches. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/p/12345

miko: adding a guard in autoscaler config to avoid scaling decisions based solely on batched latencies.

rachel: decision log: manual intervention canceled auto-rollback; rolled patch to canary behind feature flag; pins not required. follow-up: promote patch to staged after 1h of healthy metrics, then to prod. owners: dave (fix), miko (monitor), tina (customer comms).

ops-bot: logged action: ACTION-176555 -> manual-cancel-and-hotfix; linked ticket INF-3822.

ci-bot: created INF-3822 with traces and deploy logs -> https://issues.redwood.ai/INF-3822

rachel: leaving thread open until 1765562600 for final promote. thanks all. :thumbsup:
